body: Jelani S013 releases the prompt package split: product commit f4fb3245 — the three flat modules (prompts.py 1,518 lines, prompt_structure.py, rules_library.py) become backend/src/core/agent/prompt/ (structure/names/staging/rules/sections.{parent,chat,agent,personas,turn}/system/planner/pipeline) with a single import surface; chat + scoped-agent registries promoted to first-class builders; loop/orchestrator/thinker/trivial-input + 16 test files rewired, flat modules retired, zero behavior change. Verified per the bar: 3886 backend tests green (prior 38-failure set was the sandbox's missing sqlite-vec wheel), ruff/tsc/eslint clean, memory gates OK, live 8765 prompt-audit harness reproduces the exact pre-split renders (full 9,274 / staged 5,887 / turn context untouched). B-2026-11-01-26 (full execution trace) remains the owner-ordered next build.
